name: refused-uart-serial-role-missing
description: Refusal sample: a serial peer whose tx role is not a pad role of the pinned UART. The executor refuses the missing role by name (unsupported-serial:role:rts_n).
notes: this scenario exists to record the named refusal, not to pass
configs/behaviors/declaration-only/uart_serial_peer_missing_role_f5.json declares tx_role 'rts_n', which the OpenTitan UART profile does not expose
the refusal is raised by pin_group_declaration in scripts/run_inprocess_f1f6.py
